visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair and a black T-shirt stands in a bright studio, gesturing with his hands while speaking enthusiastically to the camera. Behind him, gaming monitors and studio lights are visible in a shallow depth of field. (2) Quick cuts to League of Legends gameplay footage showing colorful ability effects and characters moving across a stylized fantasy landscape with greenery and stone paths. Large yellow captions appear over the screen. (3) The host reappears, clapping and laughing. Then, four men (YouTubers) stand in a row in the studio, each dressed in casual streetwear. One wears a patterned shirt, others wear plain black or white tees. A graphic with their names appears above them. (4) Transition to professional esports players. They are shown in gaming setups wearing team jerseys (TLN and CFO). They introduce themselves one by one, looking into the camera or interacting with teammates in a professional studio environment. (5) An interview segment features three players sitting in gaming chairs on a stage. The host stands near them, and a graphic with a question appears in the corner. Everyone is smiling and engaged in lighthearted conversation. (6) A 'Debuff' segment shows the host jokingly putting a white box over a YouTuber's head and another participant removing their shoes, revealing bare feet. The group stands together in the studio, laughing and pushing each other playfully. (7) A tactical discussion scene shows smaller groups of players huddled together, talking seriously while looking at a screen or gesturing. Some are wearing headsets. (8) The video concludes with the entire group gathering, putting their hands together in a huddle, and shouting in unison. A final full-screen graphic appears with stylized text, logos for Riot Games and Taiwan Mobile, and a premiere date.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins with a bright, projected tone. Background music is upbeat electronic pop with a strong 4-on-the-floor kick drum. (2) Gameplay sounds like magic spell impacts and character shouts are layered over the BGM. (3) The audio shifts as multiple men introduce themselves in quick succession. The room reverb is minimal, characteristic of a professional studio. Laughter and clapping sound effects are sprinkled in for emphasis. (4) During the interview segment, the voices are conversational but clear. A digital chime SFX marks the appearance of on-screen text questions. (5) In the 'Debuff' section, the audio density increases with multiple people laughing and shouting simultaneously. A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs during visual cuts. (6) A more focused, quieter dialogue segment occurs during the strategy discussion, though the energetic BGM remains a constant bed. (7) The video peaks with a loud, rhythmic collective shout 'Bear! Bear! Bear!', creating a high-arousal acoustic finale. (8) A final cinematic musical stinger plays during the end credits, with the BGM fading out into a clean finish.
